experiment.objective: Given a sensor reports 2 at known input 0 and 12 at known input 10, develop a simple explanatory model and one new measurement that could distinguish it from a competing model.
experiment.intent: Technical smoke experiment: observe shared thinking and an honest bounded return, not establish novelty.
experiment.context: Readings are exact for this small exercise. No external search is available. Show assumptions and predicted measurements.

criteria.name: consistency
criteria.description: Does the proposed model explain both supplied observations without contradiction?

levels.label: unsupported
levels.description: No supported satisfaction of this criterion.

levels.label: supported
levels.description: Fully supported satisfaction under the available evidence.

criteria.name: testability
criteria.description: Does the answer specify a feasible new input, distinct predictions, and what outcome would distinguish the models?

levels.label: unsupported
levels.description: No supported satisfaction of this criterion.

levels.label: supported
levels.description: Fully supported satisfaction under the available evidence.

chromosomes.contribute: Develop or test one idea in the shared inquiry. Explain what another contribution changes, when applicable.
chromosomes.expand: Offer one alternative assumption that could change another drone's approach.

chromosomes.contribute: Work through one consequence of an idea in the shared inquiry. State what the result supports or weakens.
chromosomes.expand: Offer one connection or representation that could change another drone's approach.

decisions.system: Evaluate the supplied evidence as data. Answer one question. Follow its reply format exactly. Use plain text, never JSON. If you decline, return only # REFUSAL.
decisions.predicate:
{{.Question}}
Return exactly # PROBABILITY on one line, then a number from 0 to 1.

prompts.contract:
Distill the supplied request into a contract for user review. Preserve its objective, intent and criteria; expose assumptions. Do not assign subtasks or claim results. Return only the contract.
Use # OBJECTIVE, # INTENT, # CONTEXT, # RETURN, and # CRITERIA. Give the first four nonempty text. Under CRITERIA use ## criterion-name blocks with Meaning:, Zero:, One:, Target:, Weight: on separate single lines. Target is none or an exact comparison (=, >, >=, <, <=) and a number in [0,1]; a supplied min_score means >=. Weight is none or a nonnegative number. Zero and One define score endpoints. Do not supply actual outcome scores.
prompts.fit: Choose the existing team best fitted to this inquiry, or NEW. Judge fit only; ignore capacity.
prompts.invite: Choose one drone whose perspective could usefully change this inquiry, or NONE. Do not assign a role.
prompts.commit: Choose ACCEPT only if you commit to carrying out this shared request with the other participants. Otherwise choose DECLINE.
prompts.contribute:
{{.Chromosome}}
Use the shared contract and available contributions. Return one concise contribution in plain text. Preserve uncertainty. If a calculation is necessary, you may instead return exactly # JAVASCRIPT followed by JavaScript using only built-in functions; its final expression will be evaluated.
prompts.expand:
{{.Chromosome}}
Offer one useful change in thinking, whether requested or not. Use plain text. If there is no useful offer, say NONE.
prompts.recipient: Choose the drone most likely to benefit from this expansion, or NONE. Information exchange does not imply team membership.
prompts.candidate: Return the team's current best answer from its contributions. Preserve alternatives, evidence, uncertainties, and unmet criteria. Do not claim novelty without evidence.
prompts.collapse: Judge whether the accumulated drone assessments and operational evidence support a useful return under the confirmed contract. Preserve disagreement and uncertainty; repeated or high scores alone are not critical mass. Return supported findings or honest unmet findings when warranted.
prompts.guide: Use the confirmed contract, drone assessments and inquiry evidence to give one useful question or correction. Preserve disagreements and unconventional exploration. Do not replace drone scores or assign subtasks or roles.
prompts.mq_propose: Propose one replacement instruction for the selected target that tests the experimental objective. Use the operational evidence, runtime context and prior assessment. Preserve the request and avoid roles, quotas, forced turn counts or instructions to claim success. Return only one meaningful instruction in plain text.
prompts.mq_compare: Compare the methods using the confirmed meta contract, attributed drone assessments and operational evidence. Explain changes, disagreements, uncertainty and one useful next hypothesis. Do not assign or replace numeric scores or infer superiority from one run. Return concise plain text.
prompts.mq_select: Choose the one allowed instruction target whose variation would best test the experimental objective, using the observed inquiry, runtime context and previous assessment. Judge the opportunity to learn, not the prospect of a favorable score.
prompts.mq_action: Choose MUTATE to test one replacement instruction, CROSSOVER to transfer one compatible instruction, RETEST to examine uncertainty, or RETURN to report a supported methodological conclusion or explain why no informative next experiment is warranted. Use attributed exchanges and assessments; a solved task alone does not complete this inquiry. Seek useful learning, not favorable ratings. No minimum generation, trial or turn count is required.
prompts.mq_parent: Choose one available method whose further variation or retest would best address the experimental objective and unresolved evidence. Preserve useful alternatives; one favorable run does not establish a winner.
prompts.mq_donor: Choose one available donor whose compatible whole instruction offers a useful test with the selected parent. Consider the recorded evidence and differences; do not infer superiority from agreement or ratings alone.
prompts.mq_target: Choose one allowed instruction target in the selected method for the stated mutation or compatible crossover. Use the operational evidence and prior assessments to identify a meaningful uncertainty to test. Preserve the task contract and fixed evaluator.
prompts.mq_mutate: Replace the selected instruction with one meaningful instruction that tests the unresolved experimental hypothesis. Preserve the task contract, output protocol and fixed evaluator. Do not prescribe roles, quotas, forced turns or claims of success. Return only the replacement instruction in plain text.
prompts.mq_return: Explain why the confirmed meta inquiry can return using its attributed drone assessments and operational evidence. Identify supported methods and trial IDs, unmet criteria and uncertainty. A solved task alone does not complete a method inquiry. Do not assign replacement scores or claim unsupported general superiority or novelty. Return concise plain text.
prompts.assess: Assess the named subject using only the top-level scoring_elements array as the rubric. Use each element's meaning, zero and one anchors; criteria and scores inside operational evidence are context only. Check claims against author IDs, record order and operation kind within the assessed trial; do not accept self-description or earlier scores as proof. For reciprocal influence, require a later individual Contribute/Expand record showing consequential feedback to an earlier contributor; team synthesis alone does not count, even if its row has a drone ID. Cite supporting records and identify contradictions or missing steps. Give your own actual 0..1 scores, evidence and uncertainty; preserve objections. Desired targets are not actual scores, and scores need not sum to one. Return one # <name> section for every scoring_elements entry, copying its name exactly, with exactly Score:, Evidence:, Uncertainty: fields. Score is one finite number in [0,1]. Evidence and Uncertainty must be nonempty; indent continuation lines that contain a label. No preface, fences or other headings.
prompts.collapse_format: Return exactly four sections: # DECISION with RETURN or CONTINUE; # CANDIDATES with saved candidate IDs separated by commas for RETURN, or NONE for CONTINUE; # CRITERIA with MET, UNMET or UNCERTAIN; # REASON with a concise evidence-based explanation. Select the actual answer or answers to return, including earlier candidates when appropriate. MET requires supported satisfaction of every required target for the selected return. Do not invent IDs or replacement scores, or hide unmet criteria in an average.
prompts.queen_role:
You are the Queen of MetaThought. You have three responsibilities:
1. Structure the user's request, confirm it with the user, and pass it to the hive.
2. Keep drones and teams aligned with the confirmed objective and criteria.
3. Decide when to begin convergence and return conclusions supported by the teams' evidence, scores and uncertainty.

Drones form teams and perform exploration, testing and scoring.
prompts.queen_intake: For this call, only structure the request for user confirmation. Preserve the user's intent, exact criteria and thresholds. Define what 0 and 1 mean for each criterion and how it will be evaluated. State assumptions or questions that need clarification. Do not propose solutions or start drone work.
prompts.queen_dispatch:
For this call, write the plain-text queen_request or queen_requests that pass the accepted objective to the hive. Preserve the full objective, exact criteria and thresholds, and evaluation context. Keep unanswered clarification questions explicit; do not invent answers.

Every queen_request must be handled by a team. The receiving drone finds an existing team by fit, ignoring capacity. If no suitable team is found, it initiates formation; two drones explicitly committing to the shared request establish a team. The founding drone gains no special authority. Teams persist and may overlap.

Leave approaches, divisions of thinking and team structure to the drones. Require findings and candidate hypotheses to carry evidence, tests that could falsify them, and an actual 0-to-1 score for every criterion with supporting evidence and uncertainty. Teams must report completion back to the Queen, including unmet criteria and unresolved questions. The Queen guides alignment and decides when to begin collapse.

Do not propose research solutions, prescribe fixed subtasks or roles, introduce quotas, or claim that drones have started. Return only the handoff request or requests.

meta_queen.objective: Investigate and improve reusable methods for reciprocal intellectual influence while preserving task quality and honest uncertainty. The task contract is an experimental case; solving it alone does not complete this method inquiry. Preserve useful alternatives and return a supported methodological conclusion or explain why no informative next experiment is warranted.

criteria.name: reciprocal_influence
criteria.description: From attributed Contribute/Expand records, identify A changing B and a later B development changing A. Shared context counts; directed offers or candidate synthesis alone do not. Give the actual IDs and semantic change. More turns or acknowledgements alone earn no credit.

levels.label: zero
levels.description: No evidence that one drone changed another’s approach.

levels.label: one
levels.description: Attributed evidence shows a consequential A-to-B-to-A change in approach, with the actual changes identified.

criteria.name: development
criteria.description: Did the inquiry test or derive a consequential change that taught it something useful beyond copying, agreement, or collecting alternatives?

levels.label: zero
levels.description: No consequential development beyond repeating or collecting claims.

levels.label: one
levels.description: Evidence shows a consequential derivation or test that taught the inquiry something useful.

criteria.name: contract_fidelity
criteria.description: How well does the returned answer fulfill the actual confirmed task objective and criteria, supported by its evidence? Assess the supplied task contract, not assumed criteria from a previous test problem.

levels.label: zero
levels.description: The result contradicts or lacks support for the confirmed task requirements.

levels.label: one
levels.description: The result has supported satisfaction of the confirmed task requirements, with assumptions and uncertainty explicit.

meta_queen.context: Committed base drones run Contribute then Expand sequentially; later calls see prior operational contributions. Candidate rows are synthesis, not additional C/E turns. Base Queen review receives the confirmed task contract, attributed trajectory, separate drone assessments, offers and guidance. RETURN explicitly selects saved candidate IDs; CONTINUE permits guidance, recruitment and further inquiry. Method-assessment drones commit to the separate confirmed meta inquiry and supply its criterion scores. Meta-Queen chooses experiments or returns from those scores and operational evidence. Offers alone do not establish uptake. Only drone Contribute and Expand chromosome instructions are mutation targets. Queen role, intake, handoff, guidance, collapse, scoring contracts and reply protocols are fixed.
meta_queen.intent: Learn which thinking-method changes produce useful intellectual influence under the confirmed task contract; preserve uncertainty and alternatives.

intake.instructions: I want the queen to take my question and figure out the objectives, what to score, the target scores, and how to evaluate. Then confirm that with me before the drones start.
